findings.summary: Read the pin's SS_*_UNIFORM_FLOATS constants, assert the recorded uniform buffer sizes against them at generation and static_assert the decision arrays against those bytes in the generated source.
Refuse any task property the pin publishes outside the scalar and vector setting tables instead of dropping non-numeric ones by omission.
Assert the factory's closure-state initializers against the native temporal record's defaults.
Bind the GI resolve's absent spatialRadius/spatialPhase inputs to the pin's own nullish literals read off the resolve body rather than a hand-typed zero.
Assert the recorded enabled and disabled pass sequences against the order both backends encode, and drop the exported sequence fields nothing read.
Assert the factory keeps config.lightDirection by reference on its params and task, which the frame function's live light read relies on.
Record the allocation-identity stand-in for the pin's size compare as a fidelity adaptation.
Replace the hand-typed texture format table with the post-process lowerer's exported nativeTextureFormat, adding the two new rows there.
Read the raw and stable target formats off the recorded pipelines, checked against their attachments, and drop rawFormat/stableFormat.
Delete the unread ScreenSpaceComposition enum, its record field and the enumerator map; keep the composition string cross-check.
Consolidate the kind-keyed facts (module, factory, config type, clamp, uniform-floats constant, frame function, enumerator, stable texture) into one exported table.
Replace SCREEN_SPACE_TASK_FIELDS with scalar and vector setting lists plus a spelling function, removing the tint exclusion at every consumer.
Parse the stage bindings with variantBindings instead of a hand-rolled WGSL declaration parser.
Use LoweringContext.propertyFunction, with a uniqueness option, for the factory's record/execute/writeUniforms and the temporal owner's resolve.
Widen LoweringContext.hasCall to any node and delete the local copy.
Read the factory's config defaults through nullishDefault.
Spell Math.round once as pinnedRoundCall beside pinnedHypotCall.
Make ComposedScreenSpacePass extend ComposedPostProcess and push the history copy and composite rows directly.
Unify the FrameWalker's upload and pass recognisers and the reset-event member table; drop dead locals and the resolveForWalker forwarder; memoize compositeSlots; run recordContract as a statement.
Mark the composite uniforms dirty only when a slot changed, so Dawn stops re-uploading the block every frame.
Resolve SDL_GPU sampler slots to texture roles once per program instead of matching sidecar names by string every frame.
Keep the screen-space programs for the device's lifetime on both backends instead of rebuilding them on every frame-graph rebuild.
Drop Dawn's vacuous bound-allocation identity test and SDL_GPU's per-task program memo.
Share the frame-input gathering and the pass-begin descriptor between the two backends' stage and clear paths.
Compose the camera world matrix once per frame function and read the view, view-projection and position off it; measured byte-identical on both backends.
Move the host-UI companion loader out of cli.ts so generation and both capture harnesses validate the companion through it, loaded once per parity run and present in canvas-only captures.
Resolve the helper callee through resolveFunctionDeclaration and evaluate the stored-argument-callback predicate once per node.
Reuse the post-process descriptor option loop and value compiler for screen-space settings, with a numeric-array arm, and drop the duplicate option type.
Share the frame-graph task factories' engine and scene preamble between the post-process and screen-space intrinsics.

Replace the selector-kind ternary with an ordered pattern table, look up the published stable texture through the kind table, and share the maybe-absent optional-storage spelling between declaration and assignment.
Document the singular-inverse reset event beside the disabled transition, trim narration in the user-agent sheet and cli comments, and state the clear-versus-discard choice.
Export the stage row type used by the deploy step and the header emitter; share the test option constants; make the indentation-bound assertion whitespace tolerant.
A tag-only selector kind would let a companion keep the page's bare `button {}` base rule instead of an ancestor-class/tag rewrite that ties by specificity.
findings.blockedBy: The scene-stylesheet parser would have to accept bare tag selectors for the sheets scenes create, a grammar extension nobody has reviewed; the rewrite preserves the page's cascade outcome by source order.

findings.summary: Resolve `line-height: normal` from the loaded face's metrics per element instead of a per-family ratio on the document root and the button rule.
findings.blockedBy: RmlUi has no line-height normal; a compatibility patch resolving it per element has not been measured against the browser's per-size rounding of ascent, descent and line gap.

findings.summary: SDL_GPU could load the producer and resolve targets with DONT_CARE since the fullscreen draw covers every texel.
findings.blockedBy: It departs from the pin's recorded loadOp clear that composition asserts, and the saving of one fast-clear per target per frame is unmeasured.

findings.summary: A general 'expression reaches a stored callback' relation would replace the syntactic stored-argument-callback rule, covering aliases, pass-through helpers and method callees.
findings.blockedBy: A retention relation over aliases and pass-through calls needs the typed user-code IR's escape graph, which does not exist yet.
findings.filedIn: TODO.md (P1 Compiler model: typed user-code IR with escape graph and retaining-sink model)

findings.summary: Use the translator's exported record shapes, absent binding, call-shape lookup and snakeCase in the live node-particle lowerer instead of private copies.
Move snakeCase to cpp-literals and spell the screen-space setting names through it.
Lower the live simulation functions through lowerPinnedFunctionParts with the state as a leading parameter instead of a hand-composed signature.
Share the browser-texture producer's same-file closure walk with the executed-URL gate.

Trim the live lowerer: dead member() parameters, engine/Math/Number builtins, Env.entries, the unreachable cell arm and redundant truthiness arms; one members map, one buffer prefix, a module-level indexed call and Math table, a non-throwing free-name lookup, slot naming at install and a column storage table.
Export SLOT_NAMES and HOOK_NAMES, assert them against createParticleSystem's literal and the ParticleSystem interface, and interpolate them into the bake driver and the test.
Execute the pin's isInputConnected, parseInputLiteral and capacity rule instead of restating them; reproduce the whole set's traversal log and compare it with the driver's.
Read the evaluator registry switch once per lowerer and assert the build walk once.

Replace the parallel LiveSystem table and per-row trampolines with one LiveMapping table naming its bridge row and a LiveOps template over each system's state; decide the live requests at generation instead of probing at run time; share the mapping lookup between both accessors.
Share bridge_layer_options between the frozen and live pure-2D registrars.
Read FRAME_MS through numericValue and doubleLiteral instead of a throwaway translator.
Assert the sync's saved-size, count and dirty-range tail in assertSprite2dSyncRules beside the thirteen writes.
Have the bake driver reuse the harness's bblBase64, hoist the emitter table and ship the whole per-set visit log.
Record the frozen-bake adaptation where the bake is (cli), dropping reachedNodeParticles from the adaptation context; share exactBlendOf; rest-destructure the live texture.

Decide a pending let at the no-native-type refusal (annotated lets included) and trim its allow-list; mark live bindings with nodeParticleLive instead of request-index presence and carry the request index on every binding.
Split the Dawn utility shaders once per lowering instead of once per deploying block.
Thread the Dawn mip generator into the sprite atlas binding so the chain is filled at upload, removing the pending-generation fields, template and three lambdas.
Carry SceneState::fixed_delta_ms as double so the frame clock and physics step read it without casts.
Memoize the translator's static-condition fold, which statements() evaluated twice per folded if.
Execute the pin's variant-selection predicate over the parsed block instead of restating and asserting it.
findings.blockedBy: The build-time evaluator has no Array.prototype.find or String.prototype.endsWith, which the predicate's onceValueType and localShape terms call.

findings.summary: Translate killParticle from its pinned body instead of unrolling the swap-remove over the column list.
findings.blockedBy: The translator has no binding for a list of typed arrays of three element widths; the unrolled copy asserts the pin's release and copy statements.

findings.summary: Translate syncParticleSprite2DBridge from the pin, deriving the column spellings, instead of restating its writes.
findings.blockedBy: The body throws through template literals, aliases the layer's instance and saved-size arrays and calls Number.isFinite, none of which the translator lowers; each write is asserted by shape.

findings.summary: Split BakedSystem into an atlas row and a frozen-particle row so a live system carries no empty particle table.
findings.blockedBy: No reached scene mixes frozen and live systems, so the split has nothing to measure against; a live system's row is one empty table.

findings.summary: Generalize callShapes over the translator's matrix, list and tuple call sets.
findings.blockedBy: The four sets are consumed by different translator arms and no reached pinned body needs a unified shape yet.

findings.summary: Route the remaining vec3Literal callers through recordLiteral.
findings.blockedBy: The older callers sit outside this diff and their generated output would have to be re-measured scene by scene.

findings.summary: Ship the parsed graph once per set rather than once per live bridge.
findings.blockedBy: A set-level graph table is a bake-cache format change, and no reached set has more than one live system.

findings.summary: Resolve the live mapping row at the origin-write call site instead of looking it up by request and bridge at run time.
findings.blockedBy: The row index is the lowerer's generation order, not the compiler's; the lookup is one row per pointer move and unmeasured.

findings.summary: Replace the pending-let ancestor allow-list with a control-flow depth the statement lowering maintains.
findings.blockedBy: The compiler has no definitely-assigned analysis across blocks and try; the allow-list is the syntactic stand-in.
findings.filedIn: TODO.md (P1 Compiler model: definitely-assigned locals across try/finally)
